# geometry.concepts: INearestPoint2D

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> Can find the point of itself nearest to a query point in the plane. The result
> lies on the shape; for a region it may be an interior point (the query itself
> when contained).
